create_Qwen3MoeConfig: create a Qwen3MoeConfig instance to initialize a Qwen3MoE model configuration
configure_Qwen3Moe_model: configure a Qwen3MoE model with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers parameters
initialize_MoE_layers: initialize MoE layers with num_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and decoder_sparse_step settings
setup_tensor_parallel_plan: setup base_model_tp_plan for columnwise and rowwise tensor parallel distribution across experts
setup_pipeline_parallel_plan: setup base_model_pp_plan for embedding, layer, and normalization pipeline parallel stages
